summary: The Snappy Crab (calm: the Sandy Crab), Bubblegum Bay's new recurring chaos species for Milestone 69: a 2x2 body sheet (chaos idle, claws up; the burst, mid-hop with sand flying; soothed, claw to its shell; calm, waving), drawn to the owner's critter concept sheet's style.
generationSource: Generated with Gemini from the owner's critter concept sheet for the watercolour style, proportions, and swirly purple chaos eyes, and the vfx particles sheet for the fizz marks.

edits.prompt: A 2x2 character sheet of a NEW small cartoon animal character, drawn in exactly the style of the first reference image (the cozy critter concept sheet): the same soft watercolour painting with thin warm-brown ink outlines, the same friendly simple cartoon animal proportions, and the same size of figure in each of the four cells. The character is a cheerful orange-red cartoon crab with a rounded shell, big expressive eyes on short stalks, a tiny smiling mouth, four little legs, and two modest claws. Top-left cell: the crab standing fizzy and cranky, its eyes swirly purple spirals, tiny purple fizz bubbles popping around it, claws raised ready to snap. Top-right cell: bursting, mid-hop, claws snapping wildly, sand grains and purple bubbles flying around it. Bottom-left cell: soothed, its swirly eyes drooping sleepy, one claw rubbing its shell, the fizz fading. Bottom-right cell: calm and friendly, standing tall with a gentle smile, waving one claw. Use a restrained warm pastel palette and absolutely no pink or magenta anywhere on the crab or its props; the plain background must be bright flat magenta (#FF00FF) filling every cell. No text, no labels, no shadows on the background, no faded copies, no extra figures, and every figure whole and uncropped inside its own cell.
edits.note: Rejected: the model textured the magenta background, leaving a web of background pixels that connected all four figures; the build's connected-component split failed loudly.

postProcessing.build: bun tools/art/build-person.ts crab --height=300. The shared person builder keys magenta, drops detached islands under 120 px, despills the alpha edge, scales the chaos idle body to 300 px (the crab is wider than tall; at 380 its width filled the 512 frame), and adds the shared hamster aura.

measuredCentres.bodyCentreMethod: mean opaque-pixel centroid across the four generated body frames
